tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chu gtor grangs gsog byed tshul khyer bde don tshang bzhugs so// chu gtor grangs gsog byed lugs/ thog mar chu gtor gyi yo byad bshams la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta nas/ gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig gi bar/ lan gnyis pa nas bzung grangs gsog ji tsam byed kyi bar du yo byad gsar pa re rim pa bzhin du bshams la/ swa bhā wa sogs gsum/ oṃ na maḥsogs gsum/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs gsum/ na maḥsarba sogs gsum/ oṃ dzñā na a ba lo ki sogs gsum/ na maḥs manta sogs gsum/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas bya/ rang gi snying kha nas zhes pa nas/ sa mā dzaḥbar gzhung bzhin/ padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang zhes pa nas/ gtor ma rgya chen po 'di ni zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin/ srid zhu'i mgron/ yon tan mgron/ snying rje'i mgron/ lan chags kyi mgron du gyur pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /bsngo'o/ /mgron no/ /so so'i mnga' thang dang mthun pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad dang / chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod ci 'dod pa thob par gyur na bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i las nyon sdig sgrib nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang / bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin thams cad dar zhing rgyas nas 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / lan chags bu lon sha 'khon thams cad khyer nas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thogs drangs sems can thams cad la srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa 'byung bar gyur cig gtan pa med pa'i nas/ gnod pa ma byed cig gi bar/ de bzhin du swa bha wa nas bzung / gnod pa ma byed cig gi bar brgya rtsa sogs grangs bzung la/ rjes ma'i tshe/ sngags drug phyag drug nas bzung / gnod pa ma byed cig gi bar rgyun bzhin dang / /oṃ badzra satwa nas bzung bkra shis kyi bar phyag len bzhin byas pas khyer bde don tshang 'byung ngo //

//zhes chu gtor grangs gsog gi zin bris nyung du 'di yang sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis bris pa'i rtsa yig pa ni gzhu lung pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ chu gtor grangs gsog byed tshul khyer bde don tshang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
